title: Sculk Of Doom
description: Replaces everything Sculk related with.. Of Doom Man?
body:
**Have you ever wondered what it would be like if sculk was all entirely replaced by** ![Of Doom Man smiling](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2681231fa0745e33b1498c7b9e3947e60c7985e9_0.webp)?

Because I do! (check Gallery for screenshots)

So I made this *vision* for all of us! Yes, I call this a _vision_, I don't think this qualifies as a paint-over.. it's.. something else.. much worse.. (in a good way)

**Sounds preview**:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/zLGQ4YWHLpw" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

**Features**:
- _All_ sculk blocks are entirely retextured to be Of Doom Man or some part of him
- Particles are re-colored or tweaked to be akin to him
- Custom sound effects for almost everything sculk related
- Voice acting for Of Doom Man by me! (Farixe)
- (some) Project files included for you to further tinker with.. don't expect much though

Note: **Some audio might be a bit loud**, but I'm pretty sure you'll be able to handle it. And there **no translations/custom names at all**, the names stay the same to the original, and **some sounds aren't made by me**.. like the beeping and some sounds in the disc.

No, **Of Doom Man did not use any substances** to become like this, he's just like this already.. at-least.. the way I see it. *My vision*.

I'm just sharing a small part of my mind to the world, I assure you it's not entirely this lol
Special thanks to a friend for helping me come up with ideas for certain aspects of this vision

_"wtf is bro cooking" - my friend, after seeing the first development screenshot_
